input.rationale: Section 9 ("Warranties") is limited to mutual corporate-authority representations (p0056–p0057) and a Globix Agreement acknowledgement (p0058). HDI gives no warranty that the Services will be performed to any standard, no warranty that the Site, software or deliverables will conform to documentation, no warranty period, and no repair/replace/re-perform/refund remedy. Article 1 (p0005–p0014) contains performance covenants only, and §1.6's sole consequence of late delivery is a termination right — not a warranty remedy; §7.2's compliance-with-laws covenant is limited to advertising. Searches for "AS IS", disclaimer, merchantability, conformance, professional/workmanlike, malicious code and remedy language returned nothing, so there is no disclaimer to carve out either. The agreement therefore fails every fallback element (no 90-day software conformance warranty, no 30-day Services warranty, no repair/replacement, no refund), which is a deviation requiring insertion. We insert the preferred warranty and remedy as new Section 9(c), which survives for two years under §10.7; we would accept the fallback (90 days software / 30 days Services, same remedies) if HDI resists the 12-month period.

proposal.summary: Insert an HDI performance and conformance warranty with repair/replace/refund remedy as new Section 9(c).
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 9 gives us only authority representations, so HDI presently stands behind neither its Services nor the Site it delivers and we have no warranty remedy. We have added our preferred position: Services performed in a professional and workmanlike manner (90 days), 12-month conformance of the Site, software and deliverables to their documentation, compliance with applicable laws and no malicious code, with re-performance, repair or replacement, or refund. We can fall back to 90 days for software and 30 days for Services with the same remedies.

ops.text: HDI warrants that (1) the Services will be performed in a professional and workmanlike manner, and such warranty shall apply for ninety (90) days after performance; (2) for twelve (12) months after delivery, the Site and all software and other deliverables provided by HDI will conform in all material respects to their documentation; (3) the Services and the Site will comply with all applicable laws; and (4) the Services, the Site and all such software and deliverables will contain no viruses or other malicious code. The Company's remedy for breach of this Section 9(c) is, at HDI's option, re-performance, repair or replacement, or refund of the fees paid for the non-conforming Services, software or deliverable.
